meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Motion Identity & Interaction Choreography

principles.concept: Reveal through time: motion clarifies continuity, spatial relationship and discovery
principles.character: quiet, cinematic, deliberate; never flashy, bouncy or game-like
principles.priority: meaning first, continuity second, decoration last
principles.effects: glow/parallax/blur are optional application treatments and never required for comprehension

timing.cinematic: 600–900ms — hero/logo reveal only; never blocks interaction

easing.linear: linear only for true progress/time playback

logo_reveal.sequence: Time layers establish → Journey path reveals → negative-space Reveal resolves
logo_reveal.rules: one-shot brand/application moment; no mandatory glow; static logo remains fully recognizable

map_selection.sequence: marker boundary/scale → label/panel response → optional camera move
map_selection.rules: anchor must remain spatially stable; no bounce

map_camera.rules: use only when context benefits; preserve orientation; user input interrupts immediately

story_scene.sequence: outgoing context softens → spatial/time continuity maintained → incoming scene settles
story_scene.rules: avoid theatrical page flips; citations/evidence never delayed behind animation

journey_progress.sequence: current stop changes → route progress updates → content focus follows
journey_progress.rules: route progress is semantic; never decorative looping

overlay_panel.rules: fade + small translate/scale; focus moves correctly; background motion restrained

then_now.rules: explicit Then/Now state remains visible; crossfade/slider motion cannot be sole cue

connection_graph.rules: highlight related nodes/edges progressively; do not animate whole graph continuously

loading.rules: prefer structural skeleton/progress; avoid mystical looping ornament as default

reduced_motion.trigger: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and native platform equivalent
reduced_motion.replace: remove parallax, camera fly, path drawing, large scale/translate and cinematic sequences
reduced_motion.retain: instant state changes, opacity where safe, focus/state visibility, semantic progress
reduced_motion.logo: show final static master or minimal <=150ms opacity transition
reduced_motion.map: jump/short fade to target rather than fly animation
reduced_motion.journey: update route/state immediately without drawn-path animation

accessibility.interruptible: motion triggered by user navigation must be interruptible
accessibility.no_blocking: essential content/actions cannot wait for decorative animation
accessibility.focus: focus location must follow overlays/navigation independent of animation
accessibility.autoplay: continuous ambient motion off by default on content-heavy surfaces; pause controls if meaningful autoplay exists
